question: How many total registered users are there in the platform?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_users FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users`

question: How many users registered in the year 2023?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_2023 FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023

question: How many total orders have been placed in total?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders`

question: How many order items have a status of 'Cancelled'?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_items FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE status = 'Cancelled'

question: What is the total number of unique products in the catalog?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total_products FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`

question: What is the total net sales revenue from all non-cancelled and non-returned order items?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS net_revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

question: What was the total net sales revenue generated in the year 2023?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS revenue_2023 FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023

question: What is the average sale price across all items sold (excluding cancelled and returned items)?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(sale_price), 2) AS avg_sale_price FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

question: What is the overall Average Order Value (AOV) for valid completed/shipped orders?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sale_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS aov FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

question: How much revenue was lost due to cancelled order items?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS lost_revenue_cancelled FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE status = 'Cancelled'

question: How many order items were sold in the 'Jeans' category?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(oi.id) AS jeans_sold FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Jeans' AND oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

question: What was the total net revenue generated by the 'Outerwear & Coats' category?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS outerwear_revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Outerwear & Coats' AND oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

question: Which product category has generated the highest total net revenue?
expected_sql: SELECT p.category FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.sale_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the top-selling brand by number of units sold (excluding cancelled and returned)?
expected_sql: SELECT p.brand FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY COUNT(oi.id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many sweaters were sold in 2023?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(oi.id) AS sweaters_sold_2023 FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Sweaters' AND oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2023

question: How many physical inventory items are currently in stock (unsold)?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS in_stock_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.inventory_items` WHERE sold_at IS NULL

question: What is the total cost of all unsold inventory currently in stock?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS total_inventory_cost FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.inventory_items` WHERE sold_at IS NULL

question: What is the potential retail value of all unsold inventory items in stock?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(product_retail_price), 2) AS total_retail_value FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.inventory_items` WHERE sold_at IS NULL

question: How many total distribution centers are there in the system?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_distribution_centers FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.distribution_centers`

question: Which distribution center name currently holds the largest number of unsold inventory items?
expected_sql: SELECT dc.name FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.inventory_items` ii JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.distribution_centers` dc ON ii.product_distribution_center_id = dc.id WHERE ii.sold_at IS NULL GROUP BY dc.name ORDER BY COUNT(ii.id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which country has the highest number of registered users?
expected_sql: SELECT country FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many registered users acquired came from 'Search' traffic source?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS search_users FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` WHERE traffic_source = 'Search'

question: What is the overall order return rate percentage?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNTIF(status = 'Returned') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items`

question: What is the average age of female users who registered on the platform?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS avg_female_age FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` WHERE gender = 'F'

question: What is the highest total amount spent by any single customer on valid orders?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS max_customer_spend FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY max_customer_spend DESC LIMIT 1
